forecast.won: {method} was the most accurate over the past year: {error} average error vs {naive} for an unchanged price, {skill} more accurate.
forecast.naiveWon: Keeping the price unchanged was the most accurate over the past year ({error} average error); the other methods did not beat it.
forecast.errorsHint: Average error 1–4 weeks ahead, tested on {weeks, plural, one {# week} other {# weeks}}. Lower is better.
forecast.weeksHint: Change from last week's average ({price}), split into each driver's exact share (Shapley). The parts add up to the total.
forecast.flat: No change expected: last week's price carries over.
forecast.seasonNote: The seasonal index is built from the whole history, so past accuracy may look slightly better than it is.
forecast.mlNote: This forecast comes from the ML model: it is retrained every night on 3 years of weekly prices, season, holidays, weather, the dollar rate and demand and supply, compared with the other methods on the same past weeks, and chosen for the smallest error.

anomalies.title: {count, plural, one {# unusual day} other {# unusual days}} in this period
anomalies.note: Days when a province's median was far from what was expected are marked along the bottom of the chart. ✕ is a confirmed day, left out of the chart and statistics; ? is one of the last 4 days, kept on the chart and only marked so real news is never hidden.
